# Common Options

This chapter will be populated with content from the codebase analysis.

issues.should_add: Complete chapter documenting the most frequently used ripgrep flags organized by category
issues.fix_suggestion: Write comprehensive chapter covering: search basics (-i/-s/-S/-F/-w/-x), output control (-n/-H/-A/-B/-C), filtering (-t/-g/-u), and output modes (-c/-l)
issues.source_reference: CLI help output from crates/cli, features.json categories: core_cli, output_formatting, file_filtering

issues.description: No documentation for case sensitivity flags which are among the most commonly used
issues.should_add: Document -i/--ignore-case, -s/--case-sensitive, -S/--smart-case with examples showing when each is appropriate
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining case sensitivity modes with practical examples: searching code (use -s), searching prose (use -i), smart defaults (use -S)

issues.description: No documentation for pattern type flags (-F, -w, -x) which control how patterns are interpreted
issues.should_add: Document -F/--fixed-strings (literal search), -w/--word-regexp (word boundaries), -x/--line-regexp (full line match)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on pattern types with examples: searching for literal strings with special chars (use -F), finding whole words only (use -w), matching complete lines (use -x)
issues.source_reference: features.json:core_cli capabilities: 'Fixed string search', 'Word boundary matching', CLI flags: -F, -w, -x

issues.description: No documentation for output formatting flags that show context about matches
issues.should_add: Document -n/--line-number, -N/--no-line-number, -H/--with-filename, -I/--no-filename, --column
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining how to control what metadata appears with matches, when defaults apply, and how to override them
issues.source_reference: features.json:output_formatting capabilities: 'Line numbers', 'Column numbers', 'File path printing', CLI flags: -n, -N, -H, -I, --column

issues.description: No documentation for context flags (-A/-B/-C) which are essential for understanding matches
issues.should_add: Document -A/--after-context, -B/--before-context, -C/--context with examples showing how to see surrounding lines
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with examples: 'rg -A 3 pattern' (3 lines after), 'rg -B 2 pattern' (2 before), 'rg -C 5 pattern' (5 before and after). Explain context separator.

issues.description: No documentation for -t/--type and -T/--type-not which are frequently used for language-specific searches
issues.should_add: Document -t/--type and -T/--type-not with examples of common file types
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section showing: 'rg -trust pattern' (search only Rust files), 'rg -tpy -tjs pattern' (Python and JavaScript), 'rg -Tlog pattern' (exclude log files). Link to --type-list.
issues.source_reference: features.json:file_filtering capabilities: 'File type filtering', CLI flags: -t/--type, -T/--type-not, --type-list

issues.description: No documentation for -g/--glob which provides flexible file filtering
issues.should_add: Document -g/--glob and --iglob with examples of include/exclude patterns
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with examples: 'rg -g '*.rs' pattern' (only .rs files), 'rg -g '!*.min.js' pattern' (exclude minified), 'rg -g 'src/**/*.py' pattern' (Python in src tree)

issues.description: No documentation for -u flag which progressively removes smart filtering
issues.should_add: Document -u/--unrestricted flag and its cumulative effect (-u, -uu, -uuu)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining: -u (search hidden files/dirs), -uu (also search binary files), -uuu (also search ignored files). Explain when each level is needed.

issues.description: No documentation for output modes that summarize instead of showing matches
issues.should_add: Document -c/--count, --count-matches, -l/--files-with-matches, --files-without-match
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section showing: 'rg -c pattern' (count lines per file), 'rg --count-matches pattern' (count all matches), 'rg -l pattern' (just list files), 'rg --files-without-match pattern' (files with no matches)
issues.source_reference: features.json:core_cli capabilities: 'Count matches', 'Files mode', CLI flags: -c, --count-matches, -l, --files-without-match

issues.description: No documentation for -q/--quiet which is useful in scripts
issues.should_add: Document -q/--quiet flag for silent operation with exit codes
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining how -q suppresses output and only sets exit code, useful in scripts: 'if rg -q pattern file; then ...'

issues.description: No documentation for -m/--max-count which limits matches
issues.should_add: Document -m/--max-count with example showing how to limit matches per file
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'rg -m 5 pattern' stops after 5 matches per file, useful for quick sampling or performance
issues.source_reference: features.json:core_cli capabilities: 'Max match limits (-m/--max-count)', CLI flag: -m

issues.description: No documentation for -v/--invert-match which is a common grep operation
issues.should_add: Document -v/--invert-match for finding non-matching lines
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with example: 'rg -v pattern' shows lines that don't match, useful for filtering out noise

issues.description: No documentation for -o/--only-matching which shows just the matched text
issues.should_add: Document -o/--only-matching for extracting matched portions
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'rg -o pattern' prints only the matched text, not the full line. Useful for extracting data.

issues.description: No documentation for -r/--replace which is useful for transformations
issues.should_add: Document -r/--replace with examples of capture group substitution
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with examples: 'rg pattern -r replacement' shows matches replaced. Note this doesn't modify files, use with -o to extract transformed matches.
issues.source_reference: features.json:output_formatting capabilities: 'Replacements (-r/--replace)', CLI flag: -r. Link to 'replacements' chapter for details.

issues.description: No documentation for -h/--help distinction
issues.should_add: Document difference between -h (short help with common options) and --help (comprehensive help)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief note that -h shows frequently used flags while --help shows all flags with detailed descriptions

issues.description: No documentation for --color flag
issues.should_add: Document --color auto/always/never for controlling colored output
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief section: --color auto (default, color if terminal), --color always (force color), --color never (no color, useful for piping)
issues.source_reference: features.json:output_formatting capabilities: 'Color support (--color auto|always|never|ansi)', CLI flag: --color

issues.description: No documentation for -p/--pretty convenience flag
issues.should_add: Document -p/--pretty as shorthand for multiple formatting options
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that -p combines --heading, --line-number, and color settings for human-friendly output

issues.description: No documentation for -L/--follow flag
issues.should_add: Document -L/--follow for following symbolic links during traversal
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that by default symlinks are not followed, use -L to follow them (beware of cycles)

issues.description: No documentation for -./--hidden flag
issues.should_add: Document -./--hidden for searching hidden files and directories
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that by default hidden files/dirs (starting with .) are skipped, use --hidden to search them
issues.source_reference: features.json:file_filtering capabilities: 'Hidden file handling (--hidden)', CLI flag: --hidden/-.

issues.description: No documentation for -d/--max-depth flag
issues.should_add: Document -d/--max-depth for limiting directory recursion
issues.fix_suggestion: Add example: 'rg -d 1 pattern' searches only current directory, 'rg -d 3 pattern' descends 3 levels
